description: Source code for a date and time management shell command module in Zephyr RTOS, providing 'date set' and 'date get' functionalities.

methods.name: date_print
methods.description: Prints the date and time in UTC format.

methods.name: get_y_m_d
methods.description: Parses a date string in Y-m-d format and fills a tm structure.

methods.name: get_h_m_s
methods.description: Parses a time string in H:M:S format, allowing missing fields, and fills a tm structure.

methods.name: cmd_date_set
methods.description: Handles the 'date set' shell command to update system time.

methods.name: cmd_date_get
methods.description: Handles the 'date get' shell command to display current system time.
